description: This file defines a class 'DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. Its main purpose is to configure the menu for detailed leave requests within the OrangeHRM system's leave module, changing the screen based on request parameters.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures menu items for detailed leave requests by setting appropriate screen views based on request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu display by selecting the appropriate screen based on the request's mode parameter; specifically, it switches between 'viewLeaveList' and 'viewMyLeaveList'.
